latestRelease.title: Version 9.7.4: The Last of the Secret Codes

items.description: Guild and reminder requests stop sending your secret code along with them. Both services have keyed themselves by the signed-in account for a while, so the field was riding along unread, and anything unread invites someone to read it again.
The reminder controls now ask for a Scholar Account instead of an old sync code, because that is what actually decides whose reminders get scheduled.
